column5: Entangles the opponent's legs with roots. It can keep the opponent locked for a moment.
Grows flowers across the stage. The flowers will grow and finally fire powerful beams.
Fires a short-ranged laser attack. The consumption is low\, so the attack can be held for a long time.
Flies away while summoning rain on her wake. The rain however is dangerous to touch.
Spins forward with her parasol. It requires recovery after use\, however it's a fast grazing attack\, so it need to be taken into account.

column2: Roses are Red\, Violets are Blue
column5: Creates a flower patch that grows into different flower depending on the button pressed. They will scatter and attack the opponent after they finished growing.
Grows a golden rose. After some time\, they will scatter\, and they are extremely damaging.
Summons a guardian fairy. They do not attack the opponent\, however they are good protection against enemy danmaku.
Pins down the enemy and fires point-blank laser at the enemy. The move is a kind  of throw\, so can't be blocked; the  enemy is at Yuuka's mercy.
Disappears from vision while dashing forward. After the opponent is reached\, she opens her palm and fires an energy blast from it.
Grants power to flowers currently on the area\, Hasting their growth to quickly reach blooming point.
The B button places a floating flower. The C button unleashes a wave of short-ranged attack directed at the opponent.
Fires an energy attack with her parasol. She's strong so the attack is bigger than the parasol actually is.
Summons a double which then fires a full power Master Spark together. If it's impossible to survive one\, there is no hope with two.
Throws a ring of bullet at the oppoennt. It looks like a giant sunflower\, but it really isn't.
Entangles the opponent with roots. It's not a strong attack but if the opponent is caught it can hurt.
Fires down a huge laser attack. Due to the amount of power she has\, the attack has very high coverage despite being aimed downward.
Fires her giant laser attack. Depending on how much energy is spent\, this can be a very powerful attack.
Grows flowers across the stage. Once they're done growing\, they fire extremely powerful beam each comparable to an attack of a strong youkai.
Dashes to the opponent quickly\, disappearing from vision. As she reach the opponent she fires a huge energy blast from her hand. It's a fast\, counter attack.
Executes a diving kick. She infused energy into the kick\, so it's quite potent.
Spins forward with her parasol\, ramming the opponent while flying over the screen several times.
Prepares the parasol and put it on standby. During this state\, whenever she grazes she spins with her parasol. It's not a danmaku and it's hard to dodge.
Summons a giant tree that absorbs everything nearby. After it's done absorbing\, it fires a giant laser downward.
Summons a floating flower that will fire a beam after it's done growing. Although the flower is small\, the beam should not be underestimated.
Enteres Photosynthesis state in which she absorbs sunlight from surrounding. After the requirement has been met\, she lets loose a powerful shockwave.
